openings.claim: Ordinary clamping alone may restrain the joint after manual target-guided pointer repositioning; no measured improvement. Replace visually tight clearance with adjustable plywood/M5 jaws pressing both rods against contact faces, without an insertion stop. Elastic loops attach jaws; cord tethers bolts, nuts and washers; all components stay inside 90 mm.
openings.discriminator: Against the same jaws at contact-only pressure, hand-tightened jaws should reduce departure under 10 N. After every exchange and target-guided adjustment, return within 2 mm and remain there ten seconds, including the 18 mm replacement, with exchanges under forty seconds. Inaccurate return despite reduced load movement defeats the complete outcome claim.
openings.probe: Attempt one captive body within 100 fabrication minutes using supplied materials and hand tools only; no drilling, adhesive or permanent rod marks, hand adjustment only, nothing falling free. Verify envelope, captivity and 18–20 mm travel first. Compare two pressure settings, each five exchanges of each original rod then two with the 18 mm replacement. Per setting, four ten-second 10 N trials follow exchanges 2, 5, 10 and 12; log times and pointer positions before/during loading. First budget swaps, eight loads and setting changes against twenty minutes. If fabrication, captivity, timing or readable displacement fails, report feasibility unresolved; caps alone establish no informative test. Probe only, not deployment.
openings.uncertainty: A workable connected layout from six plywood pieces/eight bolts, with sufficient travel, stiffness and captive retention, is unproven. Target-guided hand repositioning without rod marks within forty seconds is assumed. Uncontrolled hand force, slipping, plywood deformation, tether interference or indistinguishable pressures can defeat/confound comparison. Tighter-fit anomaly supports testing, not success.

lineage.reason: Retains clamp-only relation, full pressure rival and outcome defeat, captive construction, bounded probe and unresolved assumptions; declared uncertain fit preserved.

decision: Retain D1 as an uncertain hypothesis. Accurate return and load restraint require separate observations; resources and test caps confer no feasibility or permission to relax constraints.
